tellings.difference: Told firsthand. Adds that Graves first saw the video in a classified space and doesn't name which video it was.
tellings.link_reason: Graves himself says the released video was recorded by his good friend, which is the claim Jesse Michels relays secondhand in the story.

as_told.title: Graves recognizes the released video from the classified space, recorded by his friend

plain: One of the Navy videos of unexplained objects that the New York Times made public in 2017 was recorded in 2015 off Jacksonville, Florida, by a close friend of the Navy fighter pilot Ryan Graves, Graves says. He tells it first-hand: he first saw the video in a classified setting and says "my very good buddy" recorded it, though he won't name the friend or say which video it was. Michels later repeats it, saying Graves, who also testified under oath to Congress, "kind of admitted" the video known as Go Fast, which shows a small object moving fast over the ocean, was filmed by a buddy of his. That would put a real pilot he knows behind one of the famous clips.
